steps.name: start temporary Postgres and Keycloak
steps.cmd: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; Path('.env').write_bytes(Path('.env.example').read_bytes()); raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['docker','compose','-p','{project}','up','-d','--wait']))"

steps.name: the seed users are in the database
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -U tasks_admin -d tasksteams -tA -c "SELECT username FROM users ORDER BY username"

cleanup.name: remove temporary containers, network and volume
release the build output (the API process was just stopped)
